How many certification marks are on file with the trademark office?
SELECT count(*) AS marks FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE cast(cert_mark_in AS varchar) = '1'

SELECT stalp, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE active = '1' AND stalp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

How many people both lived and worked in Los Angeles County in 2021?

Which hours of 2022 had the highest real-time power price in New York City?

How many trademarks are sounds or scents, with no drawing at all?

SELECT avg(try_cast(enrollment AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE phases LIKE '%PHASE3%'

How many colleges are in Montgomery, Alabama?

What did the Harbor Maintenance Trust Fund collect in fiscal 2024?

How many water system lead results came in above the 0.015 mg/L action level?

How many trials of cancer immunotherapy are registered?

Scorecard Most Recent Field Of Study

How many Gene Ontology terms are mapped to Rhea reactions?
SELECT count(DISTINCT id) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2go
In which technology sectors are women most often among a patent's inventors?

What share of single audits disclose a material weakness in internal control?

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN upper(substr(cast(is_internal_control_material_weakness_disclosed AS varchar), 1, 1)) IN ('Y', 'T') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_executive.fac_general
Where are SEC operating companies most often incorporated?

How many recall campaigns were opened each year from 2015 to 2024?

Which kinds of relationship connect one Rhea reaction to another?
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea_relationships WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT p_year, count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE try_cast(p_year AS integer) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2022 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT own_entity_desc, count(DISTINCT serial_no) AS filings FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_owner WHERE own_entity_desc <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Which companies are named as applicant on the most published patent applications?

Which categories of medical equipment reach the most Medicare patients?
Medicare Durable Medical Equipment Devices Supplies By Geography And Service

How old is the average operating nuclear reactor?

SELECT facility_name, max(try_cast(number_of_completed_surveys AS double)) AS surveys FROM govblock_health.cc_hcahps_hospital WHERE facility_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much NIH money went to Johns Hopkins University in fiscal year 2020?
SELECT sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_name = 'JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY' AND cast(fy AS varchar) = '2020'

SELECT name, stabbr, round(try_cast(tcurelsc AS double) / try_cast(v33 AS double)) AS per_pupil FROM govblock_education.ccd_sdf WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '17' AND try_cast(v33 AS double) >= 10000 AND try_cast(tcurelsc AS double) > 0 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What exchange rate did the Treasury set for the euro at the end of 2024?
SELECT try_cast(exchange_rate AS double) AS euros_per_dollar FROM govblock_treasury.rates_of_exchange WHERE country_currency_desc = 'Euro Zone-Euro' AND record_date = '2024-12-31'

SELECT count(*) AS annual_reports FROM govblock_sec.submissions_filings WHERE form = '10-K' AND substr(cast(filingdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2025'
Which states consume the most natural gas?

SELECT dosage_form, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_ndc WHERE dosage_form IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Black Lung Disability Trust Fund Results
